content: A small network of two convolutional and two fully connected layers (torch, CPU, 1 thread, fixed seed). channels is the number of filters in the first layer, epochs the number of passes over the training data. Shows the accuracy, the time, a breakdown of the mistakes and what the first layer picks out of a test image, and passes predictions for every test image to compare.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Accuracy, CPU time, settings, and predictions for every test image
